public_rationale: Contemporaneous original reporting supports Marcus's figure. WIRED reported that a source familiar with M estimated its automation rate never exceeded 30%. This supports the ordinary reading about requests completed without human intervention, although Marcus presents the estimate more categorically than the reporting does.
limitations: The numerical evidence rests on one unnamed source's estimate.
The assessment does not establish a precisely measured or independently audited rate.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No more than 30% of Facebook M's requests were handled by AI.

statement.excerpt: No more than 30% of requests served by AI!

our_interpretation: The subject is the original M concierge service during its pilot, through its January 2018 shutdown.
Requests served by AI means requests handled automatically without a human completing them. It does not include every request on which software assisted a human.
The percentage concerns overall request handling, not a selected task category or the separate M Suggestions feature.
criteria.support_condition: Operational records or credible contemporaneous reporting establish that M's overall autonomous request-handling rate did not exceed 30% during the pilot.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable operational records or credible reporting establish an overall autonomous request-handling rate above 30% during the pilot.
